fieldValues.title: A bug is stopped by a problem gate it does not need
fieldValues.statement: When I find a bug I want to file it and have it worked as a bug. The flow, the claim and the grounding check treat a missing Answers line as ungrounded for every issue, so a bug waits for a problem that nobody needs to write.
source_ref: Owner, 2026-10-25: vignette d7a4db67 (srs-programme, Narrative explorations): bugs do not need problems; bugs are bugs
